svg.title: K30: the debugging ladder and incident roles
svg.desc: Three rungs: is it running, is it reachable, is it right. Each rung maps to earlier scenarios. An incident commander decides the changes, three tracks investigate, and the team changes one thing, verifies it, then moves to the next.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
